title: Glenn Gaffney named as a leader of the legacy program
place_text: CIA Directorate of Science and Technology

tellings.quote: a lot of people name Glenn Gaffne who's the director of science and technology there as being respon you know one of the last leaders of the legacy program.

plain: Michels says a lot of people name Glenn Gaffney, who was director of science and technology at the CIA, as one of the last leaders of the "legacy program", the alleged long-running secret effort to recover and study crashed craft that are not human-made. He says it on the show without naming who those people are. If true, it would put a senior CIA official at the head of the programme.
